 Jerusalem Daily: Who will form Israel’s next government?
 Netanyahu and Eisenkot are locked in a struggle to form a governing coalition in the Knesset. Accusations of foreign interference continue to fly, but officials are dismissing them as mere attempts to undermine the election results. 
Al Jazeera’s Mohammad Saleh has the latest.
